meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: in questions: а вдруг...? = and what if...?

examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level?

examples.text: Почему он вдруг сравнялся? Мы шли впереди на десять процентов!
examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level? We were ten percent ahead!

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.text: Какая разница, кто будет строить дороги?
examples.trans: What does it matter who builds the roads?

meanings.note: Of a person: я занят = I'm busy.
of a place: здесь занято = it's occupied

examples.text: Вот так на митингах говори, запомни.
examples.trans: That's how you talk at rallies, remember that.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
All right, here you go. There, look.

examples.text: Я могу вам предложить номер люкс.
examples.trans: I can offer you a luxury suite.

examples.text: Можешь в любое время останавливаться в люксе.
examples.trans: You can stay in the suite any time.
Can I go and have a look?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

examples.text: Ну, вдруг там мужчина будет неодетый.
examples.trans: Well, what if there's an undressed man in there.
Don't come in, I'm not dressed yet!

examples.text: Неужели так трудно найти хороший сюжет?
examples.trans: Is it really so difficult to find a good story?

examples.text: Неужели президент накажет вас за правду?
examples.trans: Will the president really punish you for the truth?
Do you really not care at all?
Don't laugh. Read me the number.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

examples.text: Триста тринадцатый занят, триста одиннадцатый свободен.
examples.trans: Three-thirteen is taken, three-eleven is free.

examples.text: Настя, я в триста одиннадцатом люксе, отправляй ко мне Дэна.
examples.trans: Nastya, I'm in suite three-eleven, send Dan to me.
Today is the eleventh day of the month.

meanings.en: to carry, deliver something to a place

examples.text: Я сам отнесу блюдо в зал.
examples.trans: I will carry the dish into the dining room myself.
Take the documents to the boss.

examples.text: Я сейчас сам отнесу в зал.
examples.trans: I will carry it to the hall myself right now.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

meanings.en: half a basket, half the basket

examples.text: Давай я отнесу. А, сейчас, чтобы ты по дороге полкорзины слопал.
examples.trans: Let me carry it. Oh sure, so you can scoff half the basket on the way.
We picked half a basket of mushrooms.
I wanted to ask you something.
Arkash, I wanted to ask you something.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Ты мне костюм, а я разрешаю опоздать.
examples.trans: You get me the suit, and I allow you to be late.

examples.text: Сегодня тебе разрешат играть со всеми игрушками.
examples.trans: Today they will let you play with all toys.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: свободен! = you're dismissed (a boss to an employee)

examples.trans: That's all, Samson, you can go!

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: colloquial; from лопать = to eat greedily

examples.text: Давай я отнесу, а то ты по дороге полкорзины слопаешь.
examples.trans: Let me carry it, or you'll scoff half the basket on the way.
The cat gobbled up all the sausage.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: А для него это как триста!
examples.trans: And for him it's like three hundred!
The ticket costs three hundred roubles.

examples.text: Триста пятьдесят миллионов рублей по смете!
examples.trans: Three hundred and fifty million rubles per estimate!

ходить.gloss: to walk, to go (on foot, regularly)

meanings.en: to walk, to go on foot
meanings.note: back and forth or habitually; one trip in one direction: идти

examples.text: Мальчик ходит на костылях. А она ещё и активистка.
examples.trans: The boy walks on crutches. And she's an activist, too.

meanings.note: plural only; declines like an adjective: чаевых, чаевым

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
